data.one_liner: Receive and parse exported WhatsApp chats shared from the WhatsApp app.
data.what_it_does: Enables Flutter apps to receive exported chat files shared from WhatsApp on Android and iOS. It automatically parses the chat file into members, messages, timestamps, and statistics.
use_when: You are building an app that needs to analyze WhatsApp chats
You want users to be able to export a chat from WhatsApp and open it directly in your app
avoid_when: You need real-time messaging integration via the WhatsApp API
You only need general file sharing without specific WhatsApp chat parsing
strengths: Automatically parses chat files into structured objects (members, messages, stats)
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
Provides helper mixin for widgets to easily receive shared chats
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on both Android (modifying MainActivity) and iOS (Share Extension and App Groups)
Works best with chats exported in English
data.setup_notes: Android requires changing MainActivity to extend FlutterShareReceiverActivity. iOS requires creating a Share Extension, configuring App Groups, updating Info.plist files, and modifying the Podfile.
